source_roles_and_labels_used: Only stay_id, subject_id, eligible_24h and frozen split were read for source membership; no label column entered membership, bin fitting, or token construction.

source_vocab.variable_id_definition: legacy frozen meta_mimic vars order, ID stored as index+1; padding=0

tokenization.sampling: uniform without replacement to 128; fixed seed 20261123; after aggregation
tokenization.partitioning: 64 lossless stay_id modulo partitions; no sorted-input assumption
tokenization.treatment: vaso/rrt/sedation are retained as binary start indicators

label_isolation: Token files contain no outcomes. Readout/evaluation will reread reviewed labels only after root accepts these frozen artifacts.
historical_scope: New clean source-only sensitivity; it does not authenticate old checkpoint membership or old bins.

changes: only the subject field encoding changed from object strings to fixed-width Unicode
